title: The Target
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Target', Angela suspects her husband Oscar of having an affair with a senator, leading to secret surveillance plans involving Dwight. Meanwhile, Angela seeks revenge against her husband, considering violent options, and Dwight confronts Oscar about his suspicions. The episode also features Jim discussing his plans to work part-time in Philadelphia, Pam painting a mural, and humorous office interactions. Tensions escalate with Dwight and Trevor having a tense confrontation involving a weapon, and Angela confronting Oscar about her husband's sexuality, with uncertainties about the outcomes of these conflicts and plans.
